svg.title: Cranial floor, internal (superior) view
svg.desc: Floor of the cranial cavity seen from above with the vault removed. Anterior is at the top and patient right is on the viewer's RIGHT. Anterior, middle and posterior cranial fossae are tinted regions; optic canal, fissure, rotundum, ovale, spinosum, internal acoustic meatus, jugular foramen, hypoglossal canal and foramen magnum are holes.
